run_onnx_to_caffe2: run the script to convert an ONNX model to Caffe2 init and predict protobuf files
convert_onnx_model: convert an ONNX model file to Caffe2 format using the Caffe2Backend onnx_graph_to_caffe2_net method
create_caffe2_init_predict_files: create Caffe2 init and predict protobuf files from an ONNX model with a specified output prefix
review_main_function: review the main function that loads an ONNX model and writes Caffe2 protobuf output files
summarize_onnx_conversion: summarize the ONNX to Caffe2 conversion process using argparse for model path and output prefix arguments
